$comment: Technical allowlist controlling which canonical glossary terms may be auto-linked to their definition in page prose. This is an implementation decision, not an editorial one: it exists only to prevent the rehype plugin from matching ordinary English words that happen to be glossary entries (Main, Point, Grid, Tank, Fit, Client, Character, Account, Standing, Contract, Logistics). Terms listed here are unambiguous in EVE prose. Adding a term changes no wording — it wraps the existing text in a definition control. First occurrence per page only.
